items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: all the singers – Peggy Lee, Pearl Bailey, Lena Horne. Everybody in show business loved us.

ctx.x: How many nights a year did Lambert, Hendricks, and Ross perform?

Judith could know this better than me, because she finally made me take a vacation. Judith: I traveled with him from 1959 to maybe ’60, ’61. I said, “Jon, you really have to take two weeks off. People rest, actually.” So maybe they had a couple of days between gigs, but Willard was a slave driver. He bought up everything he could buy up. They’d be at work and finish. They were always 52 weeks a year, always. I don’t know how they did it, very frankly.

You said he bought everything. Judith: All the offers, as agent. He took every offer. They just were back-to-back with all their stuff. Maybe sometimes they’d have a weekend or a few days off during the week, and stuff like that
